shared_renderer_validation.native_game_browser: Battlefield land-hover timeout, repeated in the isolated outlines check; also documented before this change. Other native scenarios before it pass.
shared_renderer_validation.webgl_game_browser: Previously recorded special-the ability-row overlap. Rendering, gameplay, layout and motion checks before it pass.

limitations: Automated WebKit is Linux WebKit, not physical Safari/iOS. The font synthetic-bold difference was reproduced and fixed, but the reported vertical frame offset did not reproduce.
The full UI generation flow uses an explicit fixture; real model generation, quality and performance were not retested.
Keyboard size changes and touch gestures are emulated.
Sound playback and mute are covered by the full UI check; click timbre still needs listening on a real device.
